title: Stir Fried Dates
description: A simple Chinese-inspired dessert recipe, perfect for warm weather. This sweet treat takes only minutes to prepare and is a great way to showcase the natural sweetness of dates.
instructions: 1. Preheat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
2. Add the melted buttery to the pan.
3. Add the dates to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until they are caramelized.
4. Serve the dates hot, garnished with a stir and fry.
